The award-winning Lytton Tribune.

You pick up the paper, and scan the leading stories:

LYTTON CRIME RATE GROWS WITH CITY by Ben Bulwer, Lytton journalist. In the past several years, the city of Lytton has grown in every way. Industry, employment, and population are booming. This once little town is now a thriving city. Unfortunately, every thriving being has its parasites.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 《Lytton 犯罪率隨城市成長》／Lytton 記者 Ben Bulwer 報導。過去幾年，Lytton 在各方面都持續擴張：產業、就業與人口都蓬勃發展。這座曾經的小鎮如今欣欣向榮；可惜凡是繁榮之處，也都會滋生寄生蟲。

Lytton is now plagued with violent crimes such as muggings and drive-by shootings. Vandalism is running rampant. Lytton teenagers are no longer spending their time at the mall and the arcade. They are turning to more destructive pastimes. Just last night, three of Lytton's young people were arrested for DUI.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 如今 Lytton 飽受搶劫、飛車槍擊等暴力犯罪侵擾，破壞公物也日益猖獗。Lytton 的青少年不再把時間花在購物中心和遊樂場，而是轉向更具破壞性的消遣。就在昨晚，三名 Lytton 年輕人因酒後駕車遭到逮捕。

See Crime, page 8.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 犯罪新聞請見第 8 版。

Rats, someone tore out page 8! But another story catches your eye:
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 可惡，有人撕走了第 8 版！但另一則新聞吸引了你的目光：

OFFICERS NOMINATED FOR AWARD Lytton police chief Randolph Whipplestick has announced the nomination of Officer Sonny Bonds and Officer Joe Morgan for the coveted "Officer of the Year" award. Both men have shown outstanding (See Officers, page 8)
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 《警員獲提名角逐獎項》Lytton 警察局長 Randolph Whipplestick 宣布，Sonny Bonds 警員與 Joe Morgan 警員獲提名角逐夢寐以求的「年度警員」獎。兩人都展現了傑出表現（警員專題請見第 8 版）。

Pleased and more than a little embarrased, you put the paper back where you got it. You can't help grinning...
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 你既高興又有點尷尬，把報紙放回原處，忍不住咧嘴笑了起來……

A newspaper lies on the table.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 桌上放著一份報紙。

It's this morning's edition of the Lytton Tribune. You see a cover story about rising crime in Lytton. Hmm, looks pretty intersting...
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 這是今天早上的《Lytton 論壇報》。頭版報導 Lytton 犯罪率上升。嗯，看起來頗有意思……

Jack's pigeonhole has a message that reads, 'I shot the last sucker that nosed around in MY pigeonhole!'
這是 Dooley 警佐。: Jack 的信箱裡有張紙條：「上個鬼鬼祟祟翻我信箱的蠢蛋，已經被我射了！」

Keep your paws out of other people's pigeonholes, Bonds.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 別把手伸進別人的信箱，Bonds。

These are pigeonholes for office mail.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 這些是放置辦公郵件的信箱。

Each officer has a pigeonhole. Mail, subpoenas, and related communications are placed here daily.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 每名警員都有一個信箱。郵件、傳票與相關通知每天都會放在這裡。

It's your partner, Steve.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 這是你的搭檔 Steve。

Hey, it's our own local celebrity, Sonny the Wonder Cop! Congratulations, buddy!
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 嘿，這不是我們本地的名人、神奇警察 Sonny 嗎！恭喜你，老兄！

You sure talk a lot, Sonny.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 你話還真多，Sonny。

Many a boring Dooley-led briefing has been endured here.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 這裡不知熬過多少場 Dooley 主持的無聊簡報。

Sergeant Dooley's office looks like a combat zone, where Dooley was the only survivor.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: Dooley 警佐的辦公室看起來像戰區，而 Dooley 是唯一的生還者。

You see the layer of dust on Dooley's bulletin board, and decide you don't really want to touch it.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 你看見 Dooley 公告板上的灰塵，決定還是別碰比較好。

Dooley's bulletin board has memos on it dating back to 1972.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: Dooley 的公告板上貼著最早可追溯到 1972 年的備忘錄。

Dooley subscribes to the "Eye for an eye, tooth for a tooth" concept. If he ever caught you with your hand in his cabinet, he'd simply take off your hand. He's that kinda guy.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: Dooley 信奉「以眼還眼、以牙還牙」。如果他抓到你把手伸進他的櫃子，恐怕會直接把你的手卸下來。他就是這種人。

This cabinet has seen better days. Dooley's as rough on his furniture as he is on his men.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 這個櫃子早已不復當年。Dooley 對家具和對手下人一樣粗暴。

It's Sgt. Dooley's chair.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 這是 Dooley 警佐的椅子。

Never touch a crazed chicken, Bonds. It could turn that beak on you in a heartbeat.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 千萬別碰發狂的雞，Bonds。牠轉眼就可能用尖嘴對付你。

Someone has played a juvenile prank on Sgt. Dooley. This chicken is blissfully adding to the crap that litters Dooley's office.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 有人對 Dooley 警佐開了幼稚的玩笑。這隻雞正愉快地為 Dooley 辦公室的滿地垃圾增添更多垃圾。

You wonder if the papers are in an order that only Dooley can understand. You decide not to disturb the balance.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 你懷疑這些文件是否只有 Dooley 看得懂其中的秩序，決定不要破壞這種平衡。

The stack of papers on Sgt. Dooley's desk is about six inches deep.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: Dooley 警佐桌上的文件堆大約有六英吋厚。

Dooley's case records. Trying to organize them could make strong men cry.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: Dooley 的案件紀錄。試著整理它們，足以讓鐵漢落淚。

GET OUT, BONDS!!!
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 滾出去，Bonds！！！

You must have something to do, Bonds. So go do it! Don't bother me!
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 你一定有事情要做，Bonds。那就去做！別來煩我！

There's trash all over the room, if that's what you want.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 如果你想看，房間裡到處都是垃圾。

Coffee grounds, orange peels, and ancient fast food containers. Nothing useful.
這是 Dooley 警佐。: 咖啡渣、橘子皮和古老的速食餐盒。沒有任何有用的東西。

It would certainly help to air out the room a bit, but a good strong breeze would throw Dooley's desk into further disarray. Let him air out his own room.

This door leads to the narcotics room.
